facts: Founding president (創會會長) of Taiwanese American Historical Society (TAHS)
Presided at TAHS preparatory meeting 2013-08-28 in Southern California
Attendees at prep meeting included 黃根深, 周實, 鄭炳全, 鄭英松, 王廷宜, 楊子清, 洪珠美, 陳隆, 周威霖 and others
Essay argues Taiwanese diaspora should document biographies and org histories for identity and solidarity
Sets five TAHS “台灣精神史觀” principles: 歷史傳承, 族群榮譽, 全民團結, 社會責任, 前途希望
References 228 and White Terror as formative historical trials of Taiwanese people
Urges second-generation networking so youth feel less isolated and take pride in Taiwanese identity
Co-authored 王能祥 profile and wrote 廖述宗 memorial in the same 2017 publication
Stepped aside after health issues; Franklin Ping Cheng served as president 2014–2017 (per 會長謝詞)
